newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks up in London in pre-Xmas action.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks up in London in pre-Xmas action.

text.p: Japanese stocks saw a small flurry of action on Thursday which sent the Nikkei 50 index up two percent despite the market's general quietness before Christmas, traders said.
At 1625 GMT London's Nikkei 50 index was up 30.67 points at 1484.32, echoing Japan's Nikkei 225 index which closed at 20,943.90 -- up 283.99 points or 1.37 percent.
Traders said the market was quite active compared with earlier in the week, with buyers in Bridgestone, Sony, Canon, Ricoh, Honda and Toyota. Selling was reported in Yamanouchi.
"Today's market jolted people into action," said one trader adding that the index could go even higher on Friday but trading was likely to die down by next week.
"London followed much the same pattern as Tokyo," said another trader. "With the holiday period approaching I'm afraid it will be quiet until Christmas."
